notes.title: Hakuoki: Edo Blossoms Now Available on Steam with a Weeklong 30% Discount and a Deluxe Pack!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31846719/7ea7cbae7b17ab3f24c58c22f438470aa52c2779.png[/img]

Your best boy is ready! [url=http://ideafintl.com/hakuoki-edo/][b][i]Hakuoki™: Edo Blossoms[/i][/b][/url] is OUT NOW for Steam with English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese subtitles! The game launches with a [b]30% weeklong discount[/b] and a [b]Deluxe Pack[/b]!

The [b]Deluxe Pack[/b] includes:
- "Character Art Collection" Art Book
- "Event Scene Collection" Art Book
- 4 PC Wallpapers
- 12 Mobile Wall Papers

The Steam version of the game also includes a [b]permanent 10% discount[/b] on the following bundles: 

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6418/Hakuoki_Edo_Blossoms__Deluxe_Bundle/][b]Deluxe Bundle[/b][/url] (the game + Deluxe Pack items)
 [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6419/Hakuoki_Edo_Blossoms__DLC_Bundle/][b]DLC Bundle[/b][/url] (the game + DLC content)
 [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6420/Hakuoki_Edo_Blossoms__Complete_Deluxe_Set/][b]Complete Deluxe Set[/b][/url] (the game + DLC + Deluxe Pack items)
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6421/][b][i]Hakuoki: Kyoto Winds + Edo Blossoms[/i] Bundle[/b][/url]

The [b]weeklong 30% launch discount[/b] allows you to purchase the game for just [b]$20.99 (original price is $29.99)[/b]! The [b]Deluxe Bundle[/b] (the game + [b]Deluxe Pack[/b] items) will be discounted at [b]$27.88[/b] and the [b]Complete Deluxe Set[/b] (the game + DLC + [b]Deluxe Pack[/b] items) for [b]$30.58[/b] with launch discount! Haven’t played [url=http://ideafintl.com/hakuoki-edo/][b][i]Hakuoki: Kyoto Winds[/i][/b][/url] yet? No worries! We also have a [b][i]Hakuoki: Kyoto Winds + Edo Blossoms[/i] Bundle[/b] available for [b]$50.98[/b] with the launch discount.

notes.title: Hakuoki: Edo Blossoms comes to Steam on March 13 with a 30% weeklong discount and a Deluxe Pack DLC!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31846719/31fb7a56b8f6064fb1abd71ffb6539e8f085bf07.png[/img]

[b][i][url=http://ideafintl.com/hakuoki-edo/]Hakuoki™: Edo Blossoms[/url][/i][/b] hits Steam, [b]March 13[/b], with a [b]Deluxe Pack[/b] and English, Japanese, and traditional Chinese subtitles!
The Steam version of the game releases in tandem with the PlayStation®Vita/PlayStation®TV North American version. The European version for the PS Vita will release on [b]March 16, 2018[/b].

The game will launch with a [b]30% weeklong discount[/b] for the main game, a [b]Deluxe Pack DLC[/b], which includes the "Character Art Collection" and "Event Scene Collection" art books, 4 PC wallpapers, and 12 mobile wallpapers, and lastly, [b]10% permanent discounts for the following bundles[/b]:

- [b]Deluxe Bundle[/b] (Game + Deluxe Pack DLC)
- [b]DLC Bundle[/b] (Game + Blossoms Treasure Box DLC)
- [b]Complete Deluxe Set[/b] (Game + Deluxe Pack DLC + Blossoms 
Treasure Box DLC)
- [b][i]Hakuoki: Kyoto Winds + Edo Blossoms[/i][/b] Bundle
